decisions.evidence: Actual generator definition requires n-by-k independent columns. Current Example explicitly gives the two length-four generators as columns, agreeing with that interface; their span and the displayed cosets are unchanged. Recomputed parity equations y1=y2 and y3=y4. Generated example has no logical consumer claim.

Directly applying translation 1100 sends 0000 to 1100 and 1111 to 0011, hence exchanges the two logical states, as current Verification 3.1 now says. It does not swap the terms within each fixed coset. Z^1010 has the stated opposite coset phases and anticommutes with the logical X. Same physical defect as the existing closed row.

Actual generator convention requires a 7-by-4 column matrix. Current Example correctly uses G-transpose while retaining G as its displayed row-basis matrix. HG-transpose=0, G has rank four, H rank three; the seven distinct nonzero H columns prove distance three and the weight-four row code distinguishes the logical coset. No source or generated-leaf interface was changed in this followup.
